outcome.description: The single final result of the call. confirmed only if the person clearly agreed to the proposed time. reschedule_requested if they asked for a different time. declined if they said no. wrong_number if the person reached was not the intended contact. voicemail if the call reached a machine. callback_requested if they asked to speak to the owner directly or the call went off topic. no_resolution if the call ended without any of the above, for example a hang-up mid conversation.

note.description: One line the meeting owner would find useful. Include any time the person proposed, in their own words, and anything they asked to pass on. Keep it under 30 words.

proposed_time_text.description: If the person suggested a different time, exactly what they said, verbatim. Otherwise empty.

confirmed_by_name.description: The name the person gave when confirming their identity, if any.

identity_confirmed.description: True if the person confirmed they were the intended contact.

disclosed_ai.description: True if the assistant stated it was an AI assistant in its first sentence.
